title: Verified graphon-game aggregates, Nash equilibria and fixed-profile perturbation bounds
contribution_type: Five complete Lean formalizations of established graphon-game results

owner.source_commit_scope: Completed owning-project editorial record and its detailed lifecycle; the owning repository remains private.

claim: For real-action graphon games on the unit interval, the exact platform statements establish best-response and aggregate-profile L2 sensitivity, aggregate existence and almost-everywhere uniqueness, Nash existence and almost-everywhere uniqueness under condition (17), and fixed-profile aggregate sensitivity under a graphon change. Full equilibrium sensitivity under graphon changes remains outside this edition.

assumptions.player_space: The unit interval with Lebesgue probability measure; profiles are real-valued L2 functions and uniqueness is modulo almost-everywhere equality.
assumptions.graphons: Real-valued symmetric measurable square-integrable kernels, not necessarily [0,1]-valued. The exact extended-real operator norm is proved finite before using its real part.
assumptions.action_space: All real numbers. General constrained action spaces are not covered.
assumptions.assumption_1: c_alpha,c_z >= 0 and the stated squared Lipschitz inequality for b; noise law is a probability measure with finite second moment and zero mean.
assumptions.assumption_4: J is C1 and uniformly strongly convex in the real action with ell_c>0; its action derivative is uniformly Lipschitz in the aggregate with ell_J>=0. For Nash and perturbation statements, J is the exact defined integral cost.
assumptions.assumption_5: Only the fixed-profile graphon-perturbation target additionally assumes c0>0 and |b(a,z)|<=c0 for every a,z.
assumptions.nash_contraction: (ell_J/ell_c)*sqrt(c_alpha)*||W||/(1-sqrt(c_z)*||W||)<1, in addition to the aggregate contraction.
assumptions.perturbation_target: Both graphons satisfy the aggregate contraction; a single L2 action profile and two exact aggregate witnesses are given. All target hypotheses, including Assumption 4, are retained.
assumptions.cost_interface: Asm4 is imposed directly on the platform-defined Bochner integral cost. A separate integrability assumption on f is not added or inferred.
assumptions.stochastic_scope: IsNash uses the pointwise minimization formulation from source Proposition 3.6. The rich Fubini-extension construction and its equivalence to the broader stochastic model are not formalized here.

limitations: These are formalizations of established source results. No mathematical novelty, exhaustive priority search, source-author endorsement or independent human proof review is claimed.
Real actions, the exact platform cost definition and almost-everywhere equality delimit the scope. The rich Fubini-extension model and the equivalence in Proposition 3.6 are not proved here.
Lemma 3.19 changes the graphon while holding the action profile fixed. It is not the full Nash-equilibrium perturbation theorem.
Theorem 3.20, finite-player approximation, the pointwise estimate (16), and the wider missions are outside this edition. No downstream automatic closure is claimed.
Internal reuse of accepted proofs is recorded, not counted as extra targets. Historical explanations retain the open/closed status at their own dates.
Verified pinned third-party compiled caches are trusted inputs; this is not a Lean/Mathlib bootstrap verification.
